Physical_Environment.Location: Department of Psychology, School of Social Sciences, Tsinghua University, Beijing, China

Block_Structure.Block_number: 6 blocks per phase (pre/post; 12 blocks total across two phases)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 60 trials per block (360 trials per phase; 720 total trials per participant across pre and post phases)

exp1.detail: Between-subject TMS design (DLPFC/LpSTS/sham). Clean data merged 2026-09-02 from three historical per-group shard files (Exp1.1/1.2/1.3, one per TMS group) into a single Exp1_Clean.csv with a Group column; the redundant Session column (identical to Phase) was dropped. Phase = test stage (pre = day 1 before cTBS, post = after cTBS); numTrials (Dataset_inf) = 720 total across both phases.
